text: {"lessons":["Selling winners feels rewarding, but I should base exits on valuation and my investment thesis rather than the pleasure of locking in gains.","My loss aversion can make losses feel especially painful, so I should set clear risk limits and follow them instead of letting emotion dictate decisions.","A few months of account results are not enough to judge a strategy; I should review performance, diversification, and trade rationale over a longer horizon."]}
